verdict.rationale: The docs say ByteAsk authenticates with magic-link email sign-in, an account login. The phrase 'no API key required by default' hints at a non-default alternative, but no ByteAsk API-key authentication mode is documented. Bring-your-own-key support for third-party model providers (OpenRouter, Groq, etc.) is a separate feature: it supplies model credentials and is not shown to replace the ByteAsk account login, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login
